title: Husky Startup Challenge
lede: Northeastern's official venture incubator program and premier pitch competition.

mission.body: HSC is a semester-long incubator and pitch competition for Northeastern student founders across all majors, programs, or backgrounds.

items.label: Bolt
items.text: For ventures with traction or funding

items.label: Keith Corso
items.text: HSC gave us the space and structure to explore our customers, market, and industry at large. None of this would have been possible without the early support and validation provided to us through the HSC program and community.
